annotations.title: Change the tool selection for a chatbot integration

description:
Change the tool selection for a chatbot integration

Replaces the tool selection for one integration already assigned to a chatbot. The `enabledTools` field decides which of the integration actions the assistant may call: null means the recommended default set for that integration type, an empty array means the assistant may call nothing, and a list of tool names means exactly those tools and no others. Tool names are the `name` values from the integration tool catalogue. A list may only name tools the permissions of the integration allow (`permitted` in the catalogue, see GET /integrations/{id}/permissions); a tool outside them is refused with 422 and error code `tool_not_permitted`, while a malformed list or an unknown tool name stays a 400 `validation_error`. The field is required: a body without an `enabledTools` key is rejected with 400, while an explicit null restores the recommended default set. The new selection is saved and then pushed to the voice engine; if the push fails the request returns 502 but the saved selection is kept, so a retry only has to repeat the push. An integration of another account answers 404 as if it were not assigned.

body.description: The complete new tool selection. This replaces the previous selection rather than adding to it.

enabledTools.description: Exact tools the assistant may call through this integration. Null selects the recommended default set for the integration type, an empty array disables every tool, and a list selects exactly the named tools.

integrationId.description: Numeric identifier of the integration whose assignment is being changed. This is the integration id, not the assignment id.
